text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we've been joined by a
photographer
who's come to capture the
students' day-to-day
life on film for an
academy brochure...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so just be natural. Walk at a nice
slow
pace, without being too stiff.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure.
Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to go ahead and eat like you
normally
do.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! ♪
Hehe, this is delicious, isn't
it, Zephyr? ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A taste as gentle as a southerly
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Okay, we're going to get some shots of
you
training now! But before that...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't help wondering, but... why
have
you been wearing your signature
racewear all
day?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Should I have worn something else? I
figured
since we're taking photos it'd be
best to dress
memorably.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
It's not necessarily a problem, but the
theme of
the shoot is "day-to-day life,"
so I worry that
signature racewear might
be a little too
conspicuous...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Trainer? Did you need me
for
something?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not trying to be disruptive. I just
wanted
there to be some photos of me
in my signature
racewear.
choice_data_list: 撮影の邪魔をしちゃダメだよ

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all, I had this racewear designed
specifically
so that everyone who sees it
will remember it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I put lots of thought into this outfit when I was designing it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
For starters, red is the most eye-catching
color.
That makes it perfect for someone
lovely like me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And since I'm going to become a super
ultra
mascot in the future, majesty is
important. That's
right—the crown.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Finally, this fluffy skirt is the perfect
length to
accentuate my adorability.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's how I, Machan the mascot, came
to
possess the loveliest and most
memorable
signature racewear of all.
Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she got pretty creative to
ensure
her signature racewear would be
as memorable as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice a large, eye-catching, red
ribbon on her
beloved skirt.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice observation. The ribbons on
my skirt
and top are the most important
part.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、そのリボンにも意味が？

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: These ribbons tie me to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They keep everyone's memories
wrapped up nice
and tight... That way,
they'll all remember me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My ribbons wrap aaall the way around
everything
and everyone...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are filled with determination.
She didn't
put in all this effort for
nothing. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Perhaps if I'm lucky, I'll get to
debut as
the academy mascot in the
brochure.
choice_data_list: 今日は勝負服でトレーニングしよう！
本当に注目される時までとっておこう

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am the lovely Machan, after all. And
it's entirely
possible that the
photographer will have some
other
ideas...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, see.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you have a moment? I'd like to
take some
photos of you for a separate
page...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan created this opportunity
through
effort alone. Reassured by her
initiative, I watch
her head off.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Good point. I'll give you that one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The moment I win a race is the most
memorable
of all. Yes, that does make
sense.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I suppose I should go get changed so I don't get my outfit dirty. Okay, time for a brief inter-machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she runs off, a vivid scene happens to
unfold in
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a day where she's shining her very
brightest,
burning herself into the
memory of everyone
watching. And I
feel compelled to do everything I
can to
ensure that day comes to pass.
